mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 69 degrees, though the air quality index is at a moderate 82. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 51 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has released information regarding the upcoming Plan Commission meeting on November 4th, which will cover various site plans and plat proposals, including projects at Ardent Glen and Milky Way. Additionally, residents can look forward to property tax bills arriving by December 15th.
We have a busy couple of days ahead. Live music is playing at Bailey's Run today and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market and music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

The Verona Police Department issued a report regarding an incident on Thursday, October 15th, where a school bus driver was arrested for operating while impaired. No injuries were reported to any students or bystanders.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to stop by before they close at 10:30 PM.
